verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for an online legal-services platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no way to drive LegalZoom with natural-language commands. The nearby items do not count: AI-generated meeting minutes is a separate feature, the llms.txt file is guidance for AI crawlers, and the two-minute specialist connection is a human service.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
